DIVIDEELEM.description: Divide Element (DIVIDEELEM). Divides target elements according to the chosen element type and divide method; the request drives the starting node/element numbering, the divide option (element type, method, per-method sub-option), subdivide and merge-duplicate-node behavior.

TARGETS.description: Element numbers to divide. Used for Equal, Unequal and Parametric Unequal methods (for Parallel Bracing and Divide By Node the target elements come from the corresponding OPTION block instead).

START_NUMBER.description: Starting-number options applied before dividing. Optionally overrides the current node/element creation numbering type.

NODE_NUMBER.description: Numbering setting for newly created nodes. Applied only when this block is present.

NUMBER_OPTION.description: Numbering type for new nodes. Enum is case-insensitive. Smallest/Largest pick the smallest/largest available number; User uses a fixed start number from USER_NUM.

USER_NUM.description: [NUMBER_OPTION=User] Start number for new nodes. Values less than 1 are clamped to 1.

ELEM_NUMBER.description: Numbering setting for newly created elements. Applied only when this block is present.

NUMBER_OPTION.description: Numbering type for new elements. Enum is case-insensitive. Smallest/Largest pick the smallest/largest available number; User uses a fixed start number from USER_NUM.

USER_NUM.description: [NUMBER_OPTION=User] Start number for new elements. Values less than 1 are clamped to 1.

DIVIDE.description: Divide option: element type, divide method, the per-method sub-option, and subdivide/merge behavior.

ELEM_TYPE.description: Type of element being divided. Enum is case-insensitive. For Planar, target plate/plane-stress elements must have zero beta angle. Wall reorders the X/Y/Z division inputs internally ({x,y,z} -> {z,x,y}).

DIV_METHOD.description: Division method. Enum is case-insensitive. Equal/Unequal/Parametric Unequal use OPTION.EQUAL_OPTION/UNEQUAL_OPTION/PARAMETRIC_OPTION with TARGETS; Parallel Bracing uses OPTION.PARALLEL_OPTION; Divide By Node uses OPTION.BY_NODE_OPTION.

OPTION.description: Method-specific option. Provide the sub-block matching DIV_METHOD.

NUM_X.description: Number of divisions in X (used for all element types).

UNEQUAL_OPTION.description: [DIV_METHOD=Unequal] Unequal-distance division definitions (grid-define relative distance strings).

DIST_X.description: Distance definition in X (used for all element types).

PARAMETRIC_OPTION.description: [DIV_METHOD=Parametric Unequal] Parametric unequal-distance ratio definitions (grid-define absolute/ratio strings).

RATIO_X.description: Ratio definition in X (used for all element types).

NUM_OF_DIVISIONS.description: Number of divisions (the brace is split into this many segments).

MAIN_POST_ELEM.description: The two main post element numbers (exactly 2 elements: first and last).

BY_NODE_OPTION.description: [DIV_METHOD=Divide By Node] Divide a single element at a node.

NODE_NUM.description: Node number at which the element is divided.

SUBDIVIDE_ELEM.description: Whether to subdivide elements. When omitted, treated as true. Used for Equal/Unequal/Parametric Unequal methods.

MERGE_DUPLICATE_NODES.description: Merge duplicate nodes option applied during division.

OPT_CHECK.description: Whether to merge duplicate nodes. When omitted, treated as true.

TOLERANCE.description: Same-point tolerance used when merging duplicate nodes. When present, updates the current node-edit tolerance.
